summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour continues his study of Al-Wajeez, focusing on the critical importance of salah (prayer) in Islam. He discusses narrations from Sahih Muslim, Sunan Ibn Majah, Sunan an-Nasa'i, and Sunan at-Tirmidhi that highlight the severe consequences of abandoning salah, including the Prophet's statement that abandoning prayer places a person on the brink of shirk and disbelief. Sh. Ali Mashhour emphasizes that abandoning salah differs fundamentally from neglecting other pillars of Islam due to its frequency—occurring five times daily—which intensifies the level of disobedience and raises questions about the integrity of one's faith.
suggested_title: The Severity of Abandoning Salah: A Study from Al-Wajeez
catchy_title: What stands between faith and disbelief?
